asks: Do you know what this place was?
Are you carrying anything you could put down?
description: Somebody standing very still, carved out of the same red stone the whole country is made of, worn smooth at the shoulders by a great deal of weather. They aren't pretending to be a statue. They're simply not in any hurry.
emotes: {it} turns its head, and a fine dust comes off the movement.
{it} settles, and the floor takes the weight without comment.
{it} raises one hand slowly enough that you could have stopped it.
looks: The grain runs up through them the way it runs through a cliff, and it doesn't stop at the neck.
There's lichen in the crease of one elbow, pale green and old.
The face has been worn down to the parts that mattered most, and those are still perfectly clear.
name: a figure cut from red rock
says: I have been standing here longer than the building.
The wind takes a little of me every year. It's a fair arrangement.
